messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: P1 - db:pg-conn-exhaustion fired (service: redwood-api-db). Trigger: pg_max_connections > 90% for 2m. Pager: PagerDuty. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 created by automated monitor. Initial responders: oncall-primary. Escalation policy: 5m -> oncall-secondary -> director.
Maria K: acked via PagerDuty. I'm jumping in. seeing 503 spikes on API and long tail latency. customers: multiple workspaces reporting 502/504.
Ryan L: saw the same. app logs show: "ERROR: could not obtain connection from pool (timeout)" from worker threads.
Olivia P: Grafana: pg_active_connections ~ 1800 / max_connections 2000. 95th percentile query time 1.9s -> 3.4s in last 5m. Redis also showing maxclients reached on cache tier-c: "ERR max number of clients reached" in logs.
Maria K: status: DB is nearing conn limit, redis cluster C is evicting new clients. This is causing request queuing + backpressure -> 502 to frontend. Impact: product search and embeddings inference hits failure for some customers. Estimated % traffic impacted: ~12% across prod. SLO risk: error budget burn.
Sachin R: I'm on CPU. what's current failover plan? Can we offload reads to read-replica-2?
Ryan L: yes, read-replica-2 is warm with replication lag ~200ms. We can flip a subset of read routes to rr-2 to reduce master load.
Olivia P: also seeing Redis ephemeral connections from background workers spike after recent churn. Could be a retry storm.
Maria K: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle nonessential background jobs (indexing, telemetry) 2) enable circuit-breaker at edge for heavy query endpoints 3) route read-only traffic to rr-2 4) add short-lived connection pool limit on app tier to fail fast and fallback to cached responses.
Emily S: I'll roll out a proxy route change to shift 30% of read traffic to rr-2 now. Pushing canary to 1 pod then 3.
Sachin R: preparing psql checks. running: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';
SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections';
```
Maria K: runbook note: if active connections > 95% and query latency > 2s -> call for DB vertical scale or connection pool hard reject. But scaling DB takes ~10-15m for RDS.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: oncall-secondary notified (5m escalation).
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Maria K at 1976543230. Auto-escalation suppressed.
Ryan L: running redis-cli on cluster-c: `CLIENT LIST | wc -l` -> ~1020 (maxclients 1024). We're nearly at the cap and clients are in CMD=connect state from workers.
Olivia P: can we temporarily increase maxclients? It's risky on prod host memory. Prefer killing retryers or backoff.
Emily S: feature-gate: /search heavy endpoint -> adding 429 fallback for 5m. rolling out now.
Sachin R: I've open a limited read-only routing plan: updating router config to send GET /v1/embeddings and GET /v1/search to rr-2 for workspaces: beta-* and public caches. Patch: ```json
{"route": "/v1/search", "percent": 30, "target": "rr-2"}
``` Applying.
Maria K: also bump app pool timeout to 1s for new connections to fail fast so upstream can trigger cached fallback.
Emily S: can we evict some huge memcached keys to reduce new client creation?"
